definitions.explanation: A mistake or misunderstanding arising from incorrect perception or judgment. Often used in formal or written contexts, and most commonly encountered in the compound {試行錯誤|しこうさくご} (trial and error).

examples.japanese: {試行|しこう}{錯誤|さくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧。
⟦{認識|にんしき}→認識：05090_ninshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{錯誤|さくご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was an error in perception.

examples.japanese: {試行|しこう}{錯誤|さくご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、ようやく⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: After much trial and error, I finally found the right method.

notes:
Most commonly encountered in the compound ⟦{試行錯誤|しこうさくご}→試行錯誤：05656_shikousakugo⟧ (trial and error), which is used far more frequently than {錯誤|さくご} alone. When used independently, it appears primarily in legal, academic, or formal written contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{試行錯誤|しこうさくご}→試行錯誤：05656_shikousakugo⟧ — trial and error
- {錯誤|さくご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧ — to fall into error
- ⟦{認識|にんしき}→認識：05090_ninshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{錯誤|さくご} — error in perception
- ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧{錯誤|さくご} — mistake of fact (legal term)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧ — mistake; the everyday word for errors of all kinds
- ⟦{誤|あやま}り→誤り：01772_ayamari⟧ — error, fault; slightly more formal than ⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧ but still common
- ⟦{過|あやま}ち→過ち：14376_ayamachi⟧ — blunder, fault; implies a moral failing or serious mistake
- ⟦{誤解|ごかい}→誤解：02769_gokai⟧ — misunderstanding; specifically about misinterpreting meaning or intent
